001package com.streamConverter.test;
002
003import com.streamConverter.CommandResult;
004import com.streamConverter.controller.PmdAnalysisController;
005import java.io.*;
006import java.nio.file.Files;
007import java.nio.file.Paths;
008import java.util.List;
009
010/**
011 * StreamConverter アーキテクチャ準拠の PMD 変換実装テスト
012 *
013 * <p>実装例としてPmdAnalysisControllerの動作確認を行います。
014 */
015public class PmdConverterTest {
016
017  /** Creates a new test instance. */
018
019  /**
020   * Executes manual tests for PMD conversions.
021   *
022   * @param args unused
023   * @throws IOException if an I/O error occurs
024   */
025  public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
026    String xmlPath = "build/reports/pmd/main.xml";
027
028    // XMLファイルの存在確認
029    if (!Files.exists(Paths.get(xmlPath))) {
030      System.err.println("❌ PMD XML report not found: " + xmlPath);
031      System.err.println("Run './gradlew pmdMain' first to generate PMD report");
032      return;
033    }
034
035    System.out.println("🚀 Testing StreamConverter PMD Analysis Implementation");
036    System.out.println("Input: " + xmlPath);
037    System.out.println();
038
039    // 3つの形式での変換テスト
040    testMarkdownConversion(xmlPath);
041    testCsvConversion(xmlPath);
042    testJsonConversion(xmlPath);
043
044    System.out.println("🎉 All StreamConverter PMD conversion tests completed!");
045  }
046
047  private static void testMarkdownConversion(String xmlPath) throws IOException {
048    System.out.println("📝 Testing Markdown conversion (AI-readable format)...");
049    PmdAnalysisController controller = PmdAnalysisController.forMarkdownConversion();
050
051    try (FileInputStream input = new FileInputStream(xmlPath);
052        FileOutputStream output = new FileOutputStream("pmd-analysis.md")) {
053
054      List<CommandResult> results = controller.process(input, output);
055      CommandResult result = results.get(0);
056
057      System.out.println("✅ Markdown conversion successful!");
058      System.out.println("   " + result);
059      System.out.println("   Output: pmd-analysis.md");
060      System.out.println();
061
062    } catch (Exception e) {
063      System.err.println("❌ Markdown conversion failed: " + e.getMessage());
064      e.printStackTrace();
065    }
066  }
067
068  private static void testCsvConversion(String xmlPath) throws IOException {
069    System.out.println("📊 Testing CSV conversion (spreadsheet analysis)...");
070    PmdAnalysisController controller = PmdAnalysisController.forCsvConversion();

077

079      System.out.println("   " + result);
080      System.out.println("   Output: pmd-analysis.csv");
081      System.out.println();
082
083    } catch (Exception e) {
084      System.err.println("❌ CSV conversion failed: " + e.getMessage());
085      e.printStackTrace();
086    }
087  }
088
089  private static void testJsonConversion(String xmlPath) throws IOException {
090    System.out.println("📄 Testing JSON conversion (structured data)...");
091    PmdAnalysisController controller = PmdAnalysisController.forJsonConversion();
092
093    try (FileInputStream input = new FileInputStream(xmlPath);
094        FileOutputStream output = new FileOutputStream("pmd-analysis.json")) {
095
096      List<CommandResult> results = controller.process(input, output);
097      CommandResult result = results.get(0);
098
099      System.out.println("✅ JSON conversion successful!");
100      System.out.println("   " + result);
101      System.out.println("   Output: pmd-analysis.json");
102      System.out.println();
103
104    } catch (Exception e) {
105      System.err.println("❌ JSON conversion failed: " + e.getMessage());
106      e.printStackTrace();
107    }
108  }
109}
